# Changelog

## 2.0.1-fortran.1

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation of Rsolnp 2.0.1.
- Added self-contained augmented-Lagrangian constrained solver.
- Added optional analytic derivatives and finite-difference fallbacks.
- Added two-sided nonlinear inequalities through bounded slack variables.
- Added KKT diagnostics and least-squares multiplier estimation.
- Added deterministic Halton multistart and starting-point generation.
- Added typed standard-form conversion.
- Added the complete benchmark registry and 18 executable benchmark problems.
- Added four tests, three examples, a demo, and direct GNU Fortran scripts.
